objective: Define the narrow future execution boundary for turning reviewed Verilator-process-to-launcher bridge fixture metadata into a wrapper-mediated Verilator-facing process plus structured launcher start, without claiming direct Verilator sidecar execution, broad native option support, runtime/ABI change, timing evidence, arbitrary filelist support, automatic GPU allocation, raw full-state equality, or production throughput.

reason: the reviewed fixture is metadata-only and needs a separate boundary before any process start
the future run should prove a Verilator-facing process accepted the expanded native option spelling before the existing structured launcher argv is started
reviewed process-to-launcher metadata, explicit sidecar context, exact launcher argv, sidecar stages, compare evidence, and timing evidence must remain separate authorities
direct in-process Verilator callbacks and runtime/ABI extensions remain larger future work
a launcher start from fixture metadata alone is already covered by the process-to-launcher CLI run and is not enough to claim a Verilator-facing process bridge
definition_decision.weakest_point: This boundary still does not execute anything. It only defines the preconditions for a future run gate. Even a successful future wrapper-mediated process start will not by itself prove direct Verilator internal sidecar execution, broad native option support, timing, arbitrary filelist inference, automatic GPU allocation, raw-state equality, or production throughput.

failure_class_boundary.verilator_process_parse_failure: the wrapper-mediated Verilator-facing process rejects or fails before expanded accelerator options are accepted
failure_class_boundary.missing_explicit_sidecar_context: target/template/shape/source context is absent before bridge or launcher start
failure_class_boundary.source_or_template_authority_failure: reviewed source closure or template authority is absent, mismatched, or replaced by an unreviewed sidecar context source ref
failure_class_boundary.process_to_launcher_bridge_failure: reviewed bridge metadata cannot be tied to exact process-to-launcher CLI metadata
failure_class_boundary.launcher_cli_invocation_failure: the wrapper attempts to start the existing launcher from structured argv but cannot start or complete launcher invocation safely
failure_class_boundary.sidecar_stage_failure: the launcher starts, but a scoped build or run stage fails before compare
failure_class_boundary.compare_failure: coverage_output_equivalence compare runs and records a mismatch
failure_class_boundary.timing_claim_without_measurement: timing or speedup is claimed without a separate timing gate

required_next_gate.name: review_verilator_native_option_parser_direct_command_path_native_invocation_verilator_process_launcher_bridge_execution_boundary_gate
must_decide: whether the future execution boundary is narrow enough after the accepted metadata-only bridge fixture
whether reviewed bridge metadata, process-to-launcher metadata, explicit sidecar context, exact launcher argv, sidecar stages, compare evidence, and timing evidence stay separate
whether unreviewed sidecar context source refs are explicitly rejected before any future run
whether direct in-process Verilator callbacks and runtime/ABI changes remain deferred
whether generated command text and fixture metadata remain noncanonical and non-authoritative
whether timing, automatic allocation, arbitrary filelist support, raw-state equality, and production throughput remain out of scope
must_not_claim: Verilator-process-to-launcher runtime execution by this definition gate

non_claims: reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
